patch.summary: Apollo.io cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Apollo.io pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.title: Apollo.io plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

lines.label: Free
lines.description: Free plan · Unlocks: contact management, lead management, prospecting · Suits: explore before committing seats

lines.label: Basic
lines.description: Trial available · Unlocks: email sequences, email tracking, sales automation · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.description: Trial available · Suits: teams whose must-have gates appear on this tier

lines.label: Enterprise

blocks.heading: Apollo.io cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Apollo.io against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (email sequences (Basic, Professional, Enterprise)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (contact management, prospecting, data enrichment) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Not a pure CRM replacement for pipeline-first teams — deals are secondary to data/engagement.. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Outbound and growth sales teams requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Not a pure CRM replacement for pipeline-first teams — deals are secondary to data/engagement.

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Not a pure CRM replacement for pipeline-first teams — deals are secondary to data/engagement.

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Credits and record-selection limits govern data usage; Unlimited plans subject to fair-use policy.

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Seat + credit consumption can rise quickly for heavy outbound teams; Enterprise is custom quote.

blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Apollo.io on identical constraints.
